method.value: Synthesize ALMA spectra at 11'' resolution and compare to IRAM 30 m CO(2-1) at the two nearest positions

analysis_steps.goal: Integrated and channel maps of EHV gas

method.value: Integrate over 20 km/s EHV range centred at |V0±37.5| km/s; six 3.33 km/s channels after correcting for the 37.5 km/s offset

evidence.quote: The EHV regime is defined as the 20 km s$^{-1}$-wide velocity range that is centered on $|V_0\pm 37.5\mathrm{~km~s}^{-1}|$
where $V_0$ is the LSR velocity of the ambient cloud (6.7 km s$^{-1}$, T04)

fitting.value: Gaussian fit to spectra for the 37.5 km/s offset

evidence.quote: We estimated the value of this offset using a a Gaussian fit to the spectra, deriving a velocity of 37.5 km s$^{-1}$

method.value: Estimate ellipse sizes and PA from extreme-velocity maps; aspect ratio gives inclination of circular disk, deprojects jet velocity

evidence.quote: the aspect ratio of the ellipse is an indicator of the inclination angle of the disk with respect to the plane of the sky

claims.hypothesis: EHV peaks are gas ejected laterally in internal bow shocks
claims.experiment: Channel and moment maps of CO(2-1) in two fields plus geometric model
claims.result: Elliptical regions with minor axis along the jet, SW-to-NE velocity sweep, opposite curvature in the two fields
claims.finding: Emitting gas is in expanding, slightly curved disks perpendicular to the jet

evidence.quote: This systematic pattern indicates that the emitting gas in each field lies in a disk-like structure that is perpendicular to the jet axis

claims.hypothesis: Expansion velocity is constant vs. increasing with distance from axis
claims.experiment: Compare constant 11 km/s model against linear 0-13 km/s model
claims.result: Constant model gives wedge patterns inconsistent with the data
claims.finding: Velocity must increase linearly away from the axis

evidence.quote: we can safely exclude a constant velocity of expansion

claims.hypothesis: Lateral ejection can affect the outflow and core
claims.result: Sideways/forward momentum 0.14; accumulated lateral momentum is almost twice the impulse needed for the cavity
claims.finding: Lateral ejection potentially impacts outflow cavity formation

evidence.quote: the sideways momentum imparted by the outflow over the last 3,000 yr is almost twice that estimated as necessary to push aside and open the outflow cavity
